Definition: properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor)
BiblicalUsage: 1) occupation, work, business; 1a) occupation, business; 1b) property; 1c) work (something done or made); 1d) workmanship; 1e) service, use; 1f) public business; 1f1) political; 1f2) religious
